title: India orders X to fix Grok to block the generation of obscene content, giving it 72 hours to submit an action-taken report or risk losing "safe harbor" immunity (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: India orders X to fix Grok to block the generation of obscene content, giving it 72 hours to submit an action-taken report or risk losing “safe harbor” immunity — India has ordered Elon Musk's X to make immediate technical and procedural changes to its AI chatbot Grok after users …
